title: Preparing for class
scenario: You are in a teacher role. Use English naturally in this before class situation.

lines.text: Good morning. I'd like to check the school schedule before class.
Sure. The principal updated the timetable this morning.
We should inform the other teachers about the change.
I have already sent them an email with the new details.
Furthermore, we need to prepare worksheets for Period Three.
I agree. If we finish early, we will have time to review.
Let me explain the new procedure to the staff members.
Thank you. Your preparation is always very helpful.
